block.name: fpga_xdmac_0
block.comment: XDMAC registers - derived from http://cognidox/vdocs/SC-507020-DD-A-XDMA%20Register%20Map.pdf. Not instanced in the RTL.

register.name: FPGA_XDMAC_INT_TC_STATUS_I0
register.comment: Transfer Complete Interrupt Status Register.

register.name: FPGA_XDMAC_INT_TC_CLR_I0
register.comment: Transfer Complete Interrupt Clear Register (Value is not meaningful)

register.name: FPGA_XDMAC_INT_TC_MASK_I0
register.comment: Transfer Complete Interrupt Mask Register (0: Interrupt disabled, 1 : Interrupt enabled)

register.name: FPGA_XDMAC_ERR_STATUS_I0
register.comment: Error Interrupt Status Register

register.name: FPGA_XDMAC_INT_ERR_CLR_I0
register.comment: Error Interrupt Clear Register

register.name: FPGA_XDMAC_INT_ERR_MASK_I0
register.comment: Error Interrupt Mask Register (0: Interrupt disabled, 1 : Interrupt enabled)

register.name: FPGA_XDMAC_START_I0
register.comment: DMA Transfer Start (Value is not meaningful). Do NOT start DMA again until the previously started DMA transfer is completed.

register.name: FPGA_XDMAC_ICG_DISABLE_I0
register.comment: Internal clock gating is disabled (0 : Clock gating enabled, 1 : Clock gating disabled)

register.name: FPGA_XDMAC_CONFIG_I0
register.comment: Configuration Register

register.name: FPGA_XDMAC_LLI_SRC_ADDR_I0
register.comment: Source Address Register (Linked List Item)

register.name: FPGA_XDMAC_LLI_DST_ADDR_I0
register.comment: Destination Address Register (Linked List Item)

register.name: FPGA_XDMAC_LLI_NXT_ADDR_I0
register.comment: Next Address Register to indicate the next linked list item (Linked List Item)

register.name: FPGA_XDMAC_DMA_STATUS_I0
register.comment: DMA active status. 1 = active. 0 = idle

register.name: FPGA_XDMAC_DMA_COUNT_I0
register.comment: Number of DMA list entries processed for the current operation.
